provider_receipt.summary: The receipts support the declared git diff --exit-code HEAD -- check, but not the broader completion claim: execution and verification evidence contains only that command, with no project inspection, contract/README comparison, or joined synthesis evidence. The command also does not detect untracked files. Independent inspection found concrete defects: src/lib.rs resolves slash-containing wikilinks by joining unsanitized input to the vault root, allowing ../ traversal outside the vault; its frontmatter model is incompatible with docs/human-knowledge-ingestion-contract.md, including numeric rather than enumerated confidence and omission of required authority/privacy/provenance fields; and MemoryStore::store serializes then discards records, so it provides no durable persistence despite the stated integration purpose.
